data.action: 睡眼惺忪地单手摇晃调酒雪克壶
data.description: 【羽毛笔 · 多索雷斯调酒】多索雷斯喧闹的地下酒吧吧台前，睡眼惺忪的黎博利少女拉菲艾拉正单手极其熟练地翻飞摇晃着不锈钢调酒雪克壶。她打了个浅浅的哈欠，将一杯渐变粉色的特调鸡尾酒推到你面前——「唔……哈啊……这是加了双倍薄荷的‘多索雷斯之夜’。博士，喝了它就不困了哦。」
data.lighting: warm ambient bar glow, colorful neon bokeh, soft spotlight
data.promptProse: Sleepy-eyed La Pluma works behind the Dossoles bar at night, shaking a steel cocktail shaker one-handed before sliding a pink gradient cocktail toward the viewer. Her white shirt, ribbon tie and apron sit behind the near counter edge. A slight low angle reveals layered bottles behind her; warm bar light and a soft spotlight illuminate her yawn while neon colors reflect along the shaker.
